description: First Pen click with no track in edit mode auto-creates a track, defers the first point until NodeCreated arrives, and enters edit mode — fixing the silent no-op where Pen does nothing without a pre-selected track
wave_rationale: Smallest, most urgent — a blocking usability bug exposed by input_router_20260713. Also removes the temp PEN-DIAG diagnostics. Land first in the batch.
notes: User: 'pen does not seem to create pointer events' then 'now only works with a track selected'. Cause: handle_path_point_interaction early-returns on editing_track_id==None. User chose auto-create. Async: new node_id returns via DbResult::NodeCreated; defer the first-point append until then (pending_pen_first_point on PathEditorState).
